brief: Layered target-toss game: ball, basket rim/backboard, rear basket and foreground rim separately, cheerful booth backdrop. Moving basket starts stationary then goes side-to-side and nearer/farther. Clear aiming area.
styleNotes: For six-year-olds: exuberant 2D children’s illustrated storybook / comic art, thick dark ink outlines, flat vibrant candy colors, hard-edged cel shading, wonky exaggerated proportions, playful oversized props and readable visual gags. No photorealism, realistic landscaping, cinematic lighting or detailed painted textures. Preserve clear small-scale silhouettes.
